description: Publish the Natural Earth countries data as a new layer in GeoServer. The data is in a PostGIS database (table 'ne_countries', database 'gis', user 'geoserver', password 'geoserver123'). When configuring the data store connection in GeoServer, use hostname 'gs-postgis' and port 5432. Log in to GeoServer at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (credentials: admin / Admin123!). Create a new PostGIS data store named 'postgis_natural_earth' in the 'cite' workspace, then publish the 'ne_countries' table as a layer. Compute the bounding box before saving.
